automation.name: Automation rules
automation.description: “When … for these cards … do …” rules: tag, suspend, move or classify cards automatically.

max_depth.label: Longest chain of rules
max_depth.description: What one rule changes can start another rule (a rule that adds a tag starts a “when you edit a note” rule). This is how many rules may follow each other in one chain; a longer chain stops, so rules can never loop forever. A rule never starts itself again.
max_depth.example: 3 → rule A may start B and B may start C; a fourth rule started by C is skipped (the history shows it).

max_runs_per_event.label: Most rule runs after one change
max_runs_per_event.description: After one change (answering a card, an import, a scheduled run) at most this many rules run in total; the rest are skipped and the history says so.
max_runs_per_event.example: 20 → even with 30 rules for answering a card, at most 20 run after each answer.

automation.heading: Automation
automation.intro: Let the app do repetitive chores for you: when something happens (say, you forget a card again), it tags, moves or suspends the cards you chose.

recipes.title: Start from a ready rule
recipes.description: Pick one: it opens filled in, you can change the tag, deck or number, and nothing happens until you save it.
recipes.matching: {n, plural, =0 {No card matches yet} one {# card matches} other {# cards match}}

tag_forgotten.name: Tag cards I keep forgetting
tag_forgotten.description: When you forget a card for the 4th time, it gets the tag “difficult”, so you can study those cards separately.

suspend_leeches.name: Pause cards that never stick
suspend_leeches.description: A card you have forgotten 8 times is suspended: it is not asked until you fix it and switch it back on.

archive_learned.name: Move learned cards to an archive deck
archive_learned.description: Cards you will remember for 90+ days move to the deck you choose, so your daily decks stay small.

tag_subtitle.name: Tag new Subtitle cards
tag_subtitle.description: Every word you catch with the Subtitle browser extension gets a tag (for example the name of the show).

suspend_flagged.name: Pause red-flagged cards
suspend_flagged.description: Put a red flag on a card with a mistake: it is suspended until you fix it and switch it back on.

untag_learned.name: Remove “difficult” once a card is easy
untag_learned.description: Once a day: “difficult” cards you now remember for 30+ days lose the tag.

automation.inbox_condition_hint: For inbox rules the query is checked against the card the proposal would become (e.g. deck:English level:B1).

automation.auto_accept_warning: This rule accepts proposals without your review: anything a paired program or plugin proposes becomes a note at once. Keep the condition narrow; each program is still bound by its daily proposal limit (Ctrl+K → local_api.inbox_daily_max setting).
